mapper.insert: INSERT INTO browse_records (user_id, article_id, browse_time, duration) VALUES (#{userId}, #{articleId}, NOW(), #{duration})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.category, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.author_name, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.is_top, a.publish_time, MAX(br.browse_time) as last_browse_time FROM browse_records br INNER JOIN articles a ON br.article_id = a.id WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 1 AND a.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY br.article_id ORDER BY MAX(br.browse_time) DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
